@pytest.mark.port_toggle: tests which toggle ports

linkedPullRequests.title: [file organization] Rename folder names to allow markers to work again
linkedPullRequests.author: yxieca
linkedPullRequests.body:
Summary:
Fixes #1668 

### Type of change

- [x] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [ ] Test case(new/improvement)

### Approach
#### How did you do it?
pytest has an issue dealing with sub-folders with the same name and being
included from. In this case, the problem was with several components has
'args' as sub-folder to hold argument parsing utilities.

This issue was initially caught when we were tryign to run the whole test
suite. Attempt was made to address this issue. However there are more in
pytest that cannot tolerate same name sub-folders.

Change 'args' to '\<feature\>_args' and change conftest.py accordingly.

This PR also reverted PR #1642 

Signed-off-by: Ying Xie <ying.xie@microsoft.com>


#### How did you verify/test it?
py.test ... ... -m bsl --collect-only

Without fix, nothing was collected. With the fix:

collected 777 items / 1 errors / 766 deselected / 10 selected                                                                                                                                                                           
\<Module tests/fdb/test_fdb.py\>

comments.author: tahmed-dev
comments.body:
I suspect there is something else going on as pytest recommends having conftest in a package scope (adding `__init__.py`).
https://docs.pytest.org/en/2.7.3/plugins.html?highlight=conftest

Edit: Adding `arp/__init__.py` and also adding this line to pytest.ini fixed it for me:
`norecursedirs = ptftests acstests`
